LanguageData.MUGB_BoneStockDesc: A broad thighbone stock makes the weapon faster and more brutal in close combat.
LanguageData.MUGB_SkullBayonetDesc: A jaw-like bayonet tears into anything close enough to reach.
LanguageData.MUGB_LongBarrelDesc: An improbably long barrel extends the weapon's effective range.
LanguageData.MUGB_BladedLimbsDesc: Blades fixed to the bow limbs make it dangerous in melee.
LanguageData.MUGB_TalkingHeadDesc: A preserved head improves neither aim nor judgment, but collectors pay well for it.
LanguageData.MUGB_PreviousOwnerDesc: Parts of the previous owner serve as surprisingly effective aiming references.
LanguageData.MUGB_BoneGripDesc: A fitted shinbone grip steadies the weapon at close range.
LanguageData.MUGB_FingerCrankDesc: A nimble fingerbone mechanism cycles the repeating crossbow faster.
LanguageData.MUGB_OverchargedShotDesc: An overcharged shell travels farther and produces a larger but less accurate blast.
LanguageData.MUGB_BoneSightDesc: A carefully aligned bone sight improves aim and doubles as a close-combat spike.
LanguageData.MUGB_ToxTipDesc: A toxic goblin mixture contaminates targets struck by the projectile.
LanguageData.MUGB_FireTipDesc: Unstable incendiary material may ignite the impact area.
LanguageData.MUGB_PiercingTipDesc: Dense, narrow points improve armor penetration.
LanguageData.MUGB_PrecisionTipDesc: Carefully shaped points improve accuracy at medium and long range.
LanguageData.MUGB_OverloadPowderDesc: An excessive powder charge hits harder and penetrates better, at the cost of accuracy.
LanguageData.MUGB_ScattershotTeethDesc: Two reduced-power shots leave almost together, with poor performance at distance.
LanguageData.MUGB_TwinNockDesc: Two reduced-power arrows are loosed in rapid succession, sacrificing accuracy.
LanguageData.MUGB_RifledBarrelDesc: Crude rifling improves accuracy at medium and long range.
LanguageData.MUGB_GutStringDesc: A tightly twisted gut string increases range.
LanguageData.MUGB_QuickReloadDesc: Prepared ammunition reloads faster but slightly reduces accuracy.
